findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_tax_summary · Private data: get_tax_summary, get_ledger_events, export_tax_file, create_verified_pnl, buy_report, get_papertrade_positions, preview_papertrade_close, get_papertrade_results, get_top_traders, get_games · Public sink: create_verified_pnl, buy_report.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_tax_summary · Private data: get_tax_summary, get_ledger_events, export_tax_file, create_verified_pnl, buy_report, get_papertrade_positions, preview_papertrade_close, get_papertrade_results, get_top_traders, get_games · Public sink: create_verified_pnl, buy_report

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
